description: Edge-case docker run invocations not covered by the native suite: a destination (which injects a destination label and rewrites the traefik router/service/middleware keys to service-role-destination), multiple secret+clear env vars, a non-web role with several raw options and multiple hosts, a volume combined with a custom healthcheck path, an alternate logging driver, and a differently-named service/image to exercise name composition and quoting.
